overviewParagraphs: Laem Chabang International Country Club is Jack Nicklaus's most celebrated design in Thailand and the unanimous benchmark for golf in the Pattaya region. The expansive 27-hole facility — divided into Valley, Mountain, and Lake nines — offers a variety of terrain and playing styles that ensures no two visits feel the same, even for regular members.

The Mountain and Valley combination is considered the premium pairing, with the Mountain nine's elevation changes and panoramic views complementing the Valley nine's strategic water features and tree-lined corridors. The Lake nine, while shorter, is relentlessly scenic and tests approach play with demanding pin positions surrounded by water on multiple holes.

For discerning golfers making the Pattaya golf circuit, Laem Chabang is non-negotiable — it is the course that all others in the region are measured against, and it consistently delivers the thorough playing experience and excellent conditioning that Nicklaus's best designs are known for worldwide.

curatorBriefHtml: Laem Chabang International Country Club (opened 1995 by Jack Nicklaus in Si Racha, 30 minutes north of Pattaya and 75 minutes from Suvarnabhumi Airport) is one of Thailand’s premier 27-hole championship layouts. Divided into three distinct 9-hole loops — Mountain, Lake, and Valley (6,772 yards Blue Tees across any 18-hole pairing, Par 72) — Nicklaus crafted dramatic boulder-strewn elevation swings, crystal-clear streams, and classic Golden Bear green complexes.

Because Laem Chabang sits right along the Bangkok–Pattaya motorway corridor (and also features floodlit night golf on select loops), it works brilliantly either as a flagship Pattaya round alongside Siam Country Club or as a transit round on transfer day between Bangkok and Pattaya.
Request the Mountain + Lake combination for maximum visual drama and strategic variety — and expect immaculate conditioning and polished clubhouse hospitality from start to finish.

scorecard.verdict: Considered Jack Nicklaus's finest layout in Thailand. 27 distinct holes weaving through steep rocky hills, natural reservoirs, and scenic valleys. A mandatory inclusion for Pattaya itineraries.

faqs.q: Which two 9-hole loops are best at Laem Chabang International Country Club?
faqs.a: The Mountain and Lake nines are the crowd favorites — combining elevated hillside tee shots and natural granite boulders with dramatic lakeside approaches.

faqs.q: How far is Laem Chabang from Pattaya and Bangkok Airport (BKK)?
faqs.a: Laem Chabang lies about 30 minutes north of central Pattaya and roughly 70–80 minutes southeast of Bangkok’s Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK) via Motorway 7.

faqs.q: How does Laem Chabang compare to Siam Country Club Old Course?
faqs.a: Both are Pattaya’s two undisputed heavyweights: Siam Country Club Old Course is a historic tree-lined LPGA classic with ultra-fast greens, while Laem Chabang delivers bolder Jack Nicklaus terrain variety across its Mountain, Lake, and Valley loops.

faqs.q: When is the prime season to play Laem Chabang?
faqs.a: November through April offers dry Eastern Seaboard sunshine and brisk coastal breezes; early morning tee times work well year-round.
